::: {.card title="Wide figure"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 24
#| fig-height: 2
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   A row of 12 small line plots of random walks, each in its own color

set.seed(1)
par(mfrow = c(1, 12), mar = c(2, 2, 1, 0.5))
for (i in 1:12) {
  plot(cumsum(rnorm(100)), type = "l", col = hcl.colors(12)[i], main = i)
}
```
:::

# Setup

## Row

::: {.card title="Setup"}
panzoom works in dashboards as on any HTML page. The YAML header turns it on for
every image:

```yaml
---
format: dashboard
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom: true
---
```

The viewer opens above an expanded card. Escape closes the viewer first, then
the card.
:::
